summary: Held through an early dip and a strong +49.5pt favorable excursion, but the leg fully round-tripped: by t=9m price had reversed to -17.5pts (78% giveback of the leg's amplitude), with CLIMAX/HA/PROPP order-flow fires all flipping against the position simultaneously and ER10 collapsing to 0.05 (no persistence left). That combination -- a large favorable move giving back nearly all of itself while multiple independent fire families agree against us -- is what told me the thesis had failed rather than just dipped, so I bailed. Next time I'd watch for the giveback-percentage crossing ~75-80% of leg amplitude combined with 2+ fires against as the earlier trigger, rather than waiting for price to actually cross back through zero.
